Name: Vanilla Tweaks - Aquarium Edition
Author: mrtaiyou
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/2I94RNq.gif[/img]
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/3VPjpXS.png[/img]

﻿ ﻿﻿ ﻿[size=4][color=#e69138][b]1.[/b][/color] Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url],﻿
﻿ ﻿ ﻿[color=#e69138][b]2.[/b][/color] Drop it inside your [b]Mods [/b]folder,
﻿ ﻿ ﻿[color=#e69138][b]3.[/b][/color] Done! From here you can:[/size]

﻿ ﻿ ﻿[color=#e69138][b]+[/b][/color][size=3][b] [/b]Enable or disable any feature. For that, run SMAPI once to generate the config file of the mod and edit it manually.
[/size][size=3] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[b][color=#e69138]+[/color] [/b]Configure your preferences better by using spacechase's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
﻿ ﻿

﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://imgur.com/zr107jZ.png[/img]

[/size]Vanilla Tweaks is a massive texture pack, reimagining Stardew Valley's artwork into my funky and controversial artstyle. This collection is a gathering of my view and interpretation of your known items and some small features, giving them brand new cool visuals to enhance your gameplay, and add diversity to your walkthroughs!

The changes go from small to big overhauls, and most of the designs presented by me reuse the original color palettes offered by the items itself. That way, the art can still fell vanilla, but with touchups. With the mod being fully configurable, you can edit it the way you prefer to use with any other retexture mods created by the community and not feel like you need to choose over one or another.

[b]Vanilla Tweaks - Aquarium Edition[/b] features Fishes, Beach Forage, Tackles and Baits, Trash, and Treasure sprites. For other packs, check the links at the bottom of the page!

﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/U9EMkX5.png[/img]

Having 1.5 giving us aquariums and filling our houses with those big water tanks and swimming creatures was one of the cooler features we got giften back then. After a while, you start wondering that if your fishes were cuter, you would appreciate it a lot more, right? Now you can showcase them often!
Each swimming fish sprite has been resprited, strengthening the new identity each one received with this retexture pack. 


﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿
﻿ ﻿[img]https://imgur.com/xAsbD35.png[/img]  ﻿[font=Tahoma][size=5]Resprited Crab Pot Fish
[/size][/font]
Crab Pot Fish and other catchables join your aquarium Fishes in the magazine! Placing crabs and snails inside your tanks was never that good, now imagine a open Oyster with a visible pearl on it? Must be wonderful ;).


﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://imgur.com/xAsbD35.png[/img]  ﻿[font=Tahoma][size=5]Redesigned Crab Pots[img]https://imgur.com/WbodRA5.png[/img][/size][/font]

Not only your shrimps and lobsters get revamped for a date, but their traps too! No more awkward looking crates floating on your farm (I bet someone will call mine awkward looking), making having them worthy of your use and attention.


﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://imgur.com/xAsbD35.png[/img]  ﻿[font=Tahoma][size=5]Emotional Pufferfish[/size][/font]

By letting a special pufferfish config in your mod files activated, you'll find that Puffers have learned what emotional damage is, imboding our human suffering (or happiness if you're lucky), thus showing it in their faces.


﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://imgur.com/xAsbD35.png[/img]  ﻿[size=5][font=Tahoma]Less-brightful items[/font]
[/size]
For all lovers of less vibrant colors, may this make your reading more rewarding. Turn them on in the config!


﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://imgur.com/fcwRjaV.png[/img]

﻿This new version of Vanilla Tweaks was brought to life with my friend [b]Airyn's [/b]help. He dedicated a portion of his time to improve the existing mod's code into something better for the users. A special thanks goes also to [b]Lani [/b]who also offered to help with the code in the early versions of the mod as well. I will never have enough words to thank them both but both of them have a special place in my heart.

I'd also like to give lots of appreciation to the SDV Discord modding community for hyping up Vanilla Tweaks so much! X)
Extra love goes to my friends, rikai, Sheku, Wildflour, Max, Soph, Red, Kall, Hime, Kedi & Erin that were there for me when I needed them, cheering me up, giving feedback and encouraging me to continue steadily working on this project.

As for the art in the mod, I took a vast amount of inspiration from and studied many incredible pixel artists that I admire. So a huge thanks to [b]Reff SQ, Achi, Imvested, Stitch, DIM, Nashor Kim, RyanKamos, Lancaster, 영이 and 고마 [/b]as well!

Lastly, I'd like to give special mention to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/71169863]Bblueberry [/url]and her mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]"The Love of Cooking"[/url]. This mod page edits and design were heavily inspired by hers, so an extra special shout out to her! :)

﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://imgur.com/6k1AK56.png[/img]
